prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: small decorative footer scribble for the Byggkollektivet homepage
Input image: sole authority for loose line quality, weak pressure, sparse density, and imperfect confidence; do not copy the window motif
Primary request: a tiny playful notebook sketch of a small ordinary bird perched on a blunt carpenter's pencil
Subject: one very simple slightly lopsided bird made from a few broken contours, two awkward feet gripping one crooked pencil, one tiny feather mark, one abandoned corrected beak
Style/medium: faint graphite and weak ballpoint, scratchy doubled lines, false starts, uneven pressure, visibly drawn by a thoughtful person who is not excellent at drawing
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2; motif occupies only the central third with abundant empty space
Annotations: one very small, mostly illegible handwritten fragment and a faint question mark; private shorthand, partly crossed out, never clean typography
Background: completely flat pure white, opaque and featureless, for later technical isolation
Constraints: fewer than twenty-five principal strokes; no shading, no detailed feathers, no realistic rendering
Avoid: cute mascot styling, cartoon polish, clean handwriting, calligraphy, professional illustration, accurate anatomy, vector cleanliness, paper texture, checkerboard, gray background, shadow, border, watermark
postprocess: Converted the generated white background to transparency, recolored the graphite marks to the footer ink color, and trimmed the transparent canvas with a small breathing margin.
